Located in: Royal Prince Alfred Hospital
Requisition ID: REQ677032
 

Sydney Local Health District is one of the fastest growing Local Health Districts in New South Wales. Our vision is excellence in health and healthcare for all!

 

About the Role

Royal Prince Alfred Hospital is one of the nation's most respected hospitals, with a distinguished history of serving the health needs of local, statewide, national and international communities. Our facilities and services are world class and our staff are dedicated, innovative and caring.
 

The Community Mental Health-Core Team model of care states: 

The "Community Mental Health Team" (Core Team) is the mainstay of the community mental health system. Core Teams and provide a range of clinical services including intake, assessment, consultation, treatment ,and care coordination. Care coordination is the main component of this model of care and includes extended care coordination, targeted packages of care, and short term care coordination. 

Consumers under the care of Core Teams will either have: 

 

Short term interventions and may be discharged or referred back to their GPs or other treatment providers after a period of weeks or months.

A period of treatment as recommended by evidence based practices.

Ongoing care and monitoring for prolonged periods.

The Mental Health Nurse will practice in keeping with the standardised Sydney LHD position description for the profession in addition to this position description. 
 

For more information, please view the Position Description 

Ideal Candidate

Current nursing registration with AHPRA.

Demonstrated competencies to provide contemporary mental health practice.

Current NSW Drivers Licence (P1 and P2 acceptable).

Access to confidential EAP counselling for staff and their families

Because we care about your health: Free annual influenza vaccination, discounted Fitness Passport membership, and free telehealth nutrition and wellness resources from qualified professionals.

For more information about other benefits, please visit SLHD Benefits

Job Advertisement: Automotive Electrician
Company Name: N K Transport AUS Pty Ltd
Location: Pinkenba QLD 4008
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum

About the Company
N K Transport AUS Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based transport and logistics company providing courier, interstate freight, specialised transportation and logistics solutions across Australia. With a modern fleet, an in-house mechanical workshop and a strong commitment to reliability, safety and operational efficiency, the company delivers tailored transport services to a diverse range of commercial clients.

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Automotive Electrician to join our workshop team in Pinkenba, Queensland. The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining and installing electrical and electronic systems across the company's fleet of commercial vehicles and transport equipment to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operations.

Key Responsibilities
• Diagnose faults in electrical and electronic systems using specialised diagnostic equipment and testing instruments.
• Test, repair and replace electrical components including sensors, switches, relays, control modules and associated wiring.
• Install and maintain electronic accessories such as GPS tracking systems, reversing cameras, telematics, communication equipment and safety devices.
• Ensure all electrical repairs and installations comply with manufacturer specifications, workplace safety requirements and relevant Australian standards.
• Maintain accurate service records and communicate repair requirements with workshop supervisors and maintenance personnel.
• Inspect electrical systems to identify defects and perform preventative maintenance to minimise vehicle downtime.
• Install, repair and maintain vehicle wiring, lighting systems, alternators, starter motors, batteries and charging systems.
• Read and interpret electrical wiring diagrams, circuit schematics and technical service information to complete repairs accurately.

Skills and Experience
• AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV in Automotive Electrical Technology, or an equivalent qualification.
• Minimum of one (1) year of relevant full-time work experience as an Automotive Electrician.
• Strong knowledge of automotive electrical systems, electronic diagnostics and fault-finding techniques.
• Experience working on commercial vehicles, vans or light and heavy transport fleets will be highly regarded.
• Ability to interpret wiring diagrams and technical manuals.
• Proficiency in using automotive diagnostic equipment, electrical testing instruments and workshop tools.
• Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and quality workmanship.

Why Join Our Team
• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
• Stable full-time employment with opportunities for long-term career growth.
• Supportive and professional team environment.
• Modern workshop equipped with quality diagnostic equipment and tools.
• Opportunity to work on a diverse fleet of commercial transport vehicles within a growing logistics business.

How to Apply
If you meet the above qualifications and are looking to build your career with a growing transport and logistics company, please submit your resume outlining your skills,
qualifications and relevant experience. We welcome applications from motivated and experienced Automotive Electricians who are committed to delivering quality workmanship and maintaining the highest standards of vehicle safety and reliability.

Location:  Maddington, Perth WA
Salary: 170,000 - $250,000
Full-time: 38 hours per week

IMGs requiring supervision: Guaranteed salary plus super, including comprehensive Level 1 supervision. 
 Fully Registered/VR GPs: Excellent earning potential with a competitive percentage of billings (up to 65%) and an established patient base (plus superannuation where applicable).

About Us
Burslem Medical Centre is a well-established, accredited general practice located in Maddington, approximately 25 minutes from Perth CBD. We provide comprehensive, patient-centred healthcare to a diverse community and are supported by an experienced multidisciplinary team committed to delivering high-quality medical services.
Due to continued patient demand and practice growth, we are seeking an experienced and dedicated General Practitioner to join our busy and supportive team.

About the Role
The successful applicant will provide high-quality primary healthcare services to patients of all ages while working collaboratively with nurses, allied health professionals and administrative staff.

Key Responsibilities
•	Conduct patient consultations and comprehensive medical assessments. 
•	Diagnose, treat and manage acute and chronic illnesses. 
•	Develop and implement patient management and treatment plans. 
•	Prescribe medications and arrange appropriate investigations. 
•	Provide preventative healthcare, health education and disease management. 
•	Perform minor medical procedures where appropriate. 
•	Refer patients to specialists and allied health practitioners as required. 
•	Maintain accurate and timely clinical records. 
•	Participate in health promotion and quality improvement activities. 
•	Comply with AHPRA, RACGP and Medicare requirements. 

Essential Requirements
Applicants must have:
•	Medical degree recognised in Australia. 
•	Current registration (or eligibility for registration) with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA). 
•	Fellowship of RACGP, ACRRM or recognised overseas equivalent (or eligibility under relevant pathways). 
•	Excellent clinical, communication and interpersonal skills. 
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. 
•	Commitment to providing high-quality, patient-centred healthcare. 

What We Offer
•	IMGs requiring supervision: Guaranteed salary of $170,000–$250,000 + super, including comprehensive Level 1 supervision.
Fully Registered/VR GPs: Excellent earning potential with a competitive percentage of billings (up to 65%)  and an established patient base (plus superannuation where applicable).
•	Busy, established practice with a strong existing patient base. 
•	Accredited medical practice. 
•	Supportive team of experienced General Practitioners, nurses and allied health professionals. 
•	Bulk billing practice with excellent earning potential. 
•	On-site pathology services. 
•	Flexible working arrangements. 
•	Strong nursing support for immunisations, care plans, procedures and chronic disease management. 
•	Friendly, collaborative and non-corporate working environment. 
•	Convenient southern metropolitan Perth location. 

How to Apply
Applicants should submit:
•	Current CV 
•	Cover Letter 
•	Evidence of qualifications 
•	AHPRA registration details (or eligibility) 

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Contract Administrator – Full-Time

Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $90,000 – $120,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Contract Administrator to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As a Contract Administrator, you will be responsible for administering commercial contracts and providing contractual support across engineering, mining, maintenance, shutdown, and construction projects. You will work closely with project managers, engineers, procurement teams, subcontractors, and clients to ensure contracts are managed effectively, project risks are minimised, and contractual obligations are met.

Key Responsibilities
•	Prepare, review, and administer contracts, subcontracts, and service agreements in accordance with company policies and project requirements.
•	Monitor contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual terms, specifications, budgets, and project schedules.
•	Assist in preparing tender documentation, contract variations, extensions of time, and claims.
•	Coordinate the execution of contracts and maintain accurate contract records and documentation.
•	Liaise with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders regarding contractual matters.
•	Review project progress and identify contractual risks, delays, or compliance issues, and recommend appropriate solutions.
•	Monitor project costs, contract budgets, and payment schedules in collaboration with project managers and finance teams.
•	Prepare progress claims, payment certificates, contract reports, and commercial correspondence.
•	Assist in procurement activities, supplier evaluations, and subcontractor management.
•	Ensure all contract administration activities comply with company procedures, legislative requirements, and Australian Standards.
•	Maintain confidential contract records and support audits when required.
•	Follow workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field.
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as a Contract Administrator or in a similar commercial or project administration role.
•	Experience within the mining, engineering, construction, or industrial sectors is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of contract administration principles, procurement processes, and project delivery.
•	Ability to interpret contracts, technical specifications, and commercial documentation.
•	Excellent negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
•	High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and contract management or project management software.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $90,000 – $120,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing professional development and career progression.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

About us

An excellent opportunity exists for someone friendly, reliable, efficient and self-motivated to join our ever growing Eye Clinic in Midland to assist with reception and administrative duties, along with some patient pre-testing.

This is a full time position, 5 days a week (Monday to Friday). With multiple doctors covering different ophthalmic sub-specialties, we are a comprehensive provider of eye care and surgery in the local area, servicing both local and regional patients.

Our practice continues to grow with the recent addition of another ophthalmologist to our team, and we are expanding our support staff to ensure we continue to provide exceptional care and service to our patients. This is an opportunity to join a friendly and dynamic team in a busy and progressive practice.

About you

Discretion, empathy and professionalism are of utmost importance to you. You thrive in high pressure, busy environments and are able to problem solve and think on the spot when required. You take pride in being a comforting smiling face for our patients to see and will go above and beyond to make their experience a pleasant and memorable one.

Qualifications & experience

- Previous relevant medical reception, administrative and/or patient testing experience highly regarded

- Ability to cope with high volume patient flow and to prioritize daily schedules to maintain a smooth workflow is a must

- Team focused mindset with the willingness to support clinicians and colleagues-

- High attention to detail and multi-tasking is essential

- Able to show compassion with emotional and intelligent patient interaction

- Resilient and adaptable

- Seamless communication with all clinicians, staff members and management

- Proven ability to use initiative and problem solve issues that may arise

Tasks & responsibilities

- Administrative duties including but not limited to; reception, answering and managing phone enquiries and emails, updating and maintaining accurate patient records, responding to and dealing with patient referrals, end of day banking

- Scheduling a variety of appointments, including surgery bookings requiring high accuracy

- Providing exceptional customer service to patients and other third parties; face-to-face, over the phone and via electronic communication

- Ability to work collaboratively in a team orientated environment

- Perform patient testing including but not limited to; visual acuity, visual field tests, biometry, IOPs, OCT scans and photos as required. Training will be provided for this

Requirements

Applicants must have full, unrestricted working rights in Australia (Australian Citizen, Permanent Resident, or valid visa holder with full work rights)

Information

Easy access via public transport

Career progression opportunities and ongoing professional development

Rostered work days required: Monday to Friday, with variable start and finish times ranging from 8am to 6.30pm, so flexibility is essential

Salary: $55,328 – $69,160 per annum plus superannuation, depending on experience

Please include a cover letter addressed to Vicky listing your qualifications and relevant experience with your application.

Applications without cover letters or AI generated will not be considered. References must be provided.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Employment Type: Temporary Full Time (38 hours per week), Temporary Part Time (minimum 24 hours per week to be considered) up to September 2027
Position Classification: Registered Nurse 
Remuneration: $41.22 - $57.88 per hour + Annual Leave Loading + Superannuation 
Located in: Royal Prince Alfred Hospital 
Requisition ID: REQ676983 

In Sydney Local Health District our vision is Excellence in health and healthcare for all. You will be working in an innovative district that celebrates and invests in the ideas of staff, values people and offers life-long careers. Join the team at one of the leading public health organisations in Australia!

About the Role

Formed in 1882, Royal Prince Alfred Hospital (RPAH) is a major metropolitan tertiary referral hospital and a principal provider of specialist healthcare. It remains one of the nation's most respected hospitals, with a distinguished history serving the health needs of local, statewide, national and international communities. 

The Acute Care Service model of care provides: 

Mental Health assessments to consumers within the community experiencing acute mental health problems (including a rapid response when indicated) and determining an appropriate pathway to care (e.g., community treatment; assist consumers access and admission to inpatient treatment). 

Short term mental health treatment in the community often as an alternative to hospital.

In reach to hospital to promote effective follow up post mental health admission. 

Collaborative care for consumers transferring between hospital and community. 

The model provides short term mental health interventions in the community for consumers experiencing mental health distress. Once the symptoms have resolved and the presentation is no longer acute the team collaborate with other stakeholders for the most appropriate ongoing care and treatment. 

The Mental Health Nurse will practice in keeping with the standardised Sydney LHD position description for the profession in addition to this position description. 

For more information, please view the Position Description.

Ideal Candidate

Recognised nursing tertiary qualifications, current nursing registration with AHPRA. 

Competencies to provide contemporary mental health practice. 

Understanding of and commitment to recovery-oriented services and consumer involvement in service provision. 

Ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with GPs, Service partners and external providers. 

Current NSW Drivers Licence (P1 and P2 acceptable). 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Benefits and Perks!

Accrued Day Off each month, paid Parental Leave & Annual Leave Loading. 

Opportunity for extra tax savings through Salary Packaging and Novated Leasing. For more information visit SalaryPackagingPlus. 

Access to free courses, qualifications and coaching via Sydney Education. 

Access to confidential EAP counselling for staff and their families. 

Because we care about your health: Free annual influenza vaccination, discounted Fitness Passport membership, and free telehealth nutrition and wellness resources from qualified professionals. 

For more information about other benefits, please visit SLHD Benefit.

This recruitment may be used to create a talent pool for similar future roles (ongoing or temporary) that may arise over the next 18 months.

Working for Sydney Local Health District - NSW Health

This is a Category A position. To be employed by NSW Health you are required to provide evidence of vaccination to comply with the NSW Health Occupational Assessment, Screening & Vaccination against Specified Infectious Diseases Policy (PD2026_004)

SLHD is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and people with disability are encouraged to apply for all internal and externally advertised positions. If you require assistance, please advise the contact person at the time of your application.

 

Stepping Up aims to assist Aboriginal job applicants by providing information about applying for roles within NSW Health. For more information, please visit: https:--www.steppingup.health.nsw.gov.au-

Sydney Local Health District is committed to implementing the Child Safe Standards.

For more information about SLHD please visit 'Working With Us'

To further connect with us, check us out on LinkedIn. 

For enquiries, please contact Donna Beeson on 0434 072 465 or via emial at Donna.Beeson@health.nsw.gov.au 

Join the team enriching health in millions of ways every day, apply now! 

Applications Close: 20 July 2026

For Applicant Support and Information, visit 'Applicant Information'    Click here to Apply now →
